- **Old entry still there:** I couldn't remove the 20 November entry from this morning's #north-team post. A lookup sees two separate records for Tamsin Cold Chain, and I couldn't reach the one holding that entry. It's still in the brain, but the new entry says it replaces 20 November.
- **Date already passed:** It's 14 October, so if she means 24 September this year, that date has gone. I told her the order form may be overdue if it's still out. I took no other action, since she said none was needed.
